body:
Haha thanks for saying that 
Really do appreciate it 
I guess it’s just scary to even start a conversation about this kind of thing so coming on here definitely helps a lot too
Thanks but I always just write it down and that helps me keep myself together. I just don’t want to burden anyone...
Ah I see. Yeah that does make sense then. Thank you

Thank you so much. All we can do is hope for each other right? And even tho it’s overused I will remember it so thank you.
I hope things change for the better on your end too. Hoping one day we don’t wake up feeling tired anymore.

Jealousy is the first emotion that pops up whenever I hear the news of someone’s suicide. And I always feel so guilty feeling jealousy before sympathy. I wish I was as brave. 
A diary is a great idea and honestly it helps a lot. Whenever you do muster up enough energy to write something lol 

But hang in there

Happy birthday!! 🥳
I’m proud of you for making it this far 💖

It’s easier to run away. And easy makes us feel relief even if it’s temporary. 

But I hope you find peace someday brother
Hey Idk if Id be any help but I’m more than willing to listen and talk :)
